name: Stray Hair
help:
# strayHair

Stray hair overlay

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------|-------------|
| density | float | 0.5 | 0-1 | Hair density |
| seed | int | 1 | 1-100 | Random seed |
| alpha | float | 0.5 | 0-1 | Overlay opacity |
